localizedValues.name: Y15
localizedValues.description:
The yurt is 16-feet in diameter by 10-feet high and is furnished with bunk beds that sleep three, a queen-size futon, overhead light, and small end table. Outside is a picnic table, fire grill, utility hookup, and a deck that is ADA accessible. Bathrooms and showers are nearby. All yurts are heated, but visitors should take along blankets and warm clothing as evenings can be cool.
A nearby pad with electric utility hookup for RV or trailer is available for $41 per night at the park.

localizedValues.name: S1-Kitchen Shelter
localizedValues.description:
Group must clean up prior to checking out. No driving on lawn. Keg alcohol is not permitted. If you have more than the maximum number of occupants you will be evicted without a refund. Shelter reservations are for typical facility use (such as picnics/BBQ's).
Shelter reservations alone do not facilitate holding events within the park (such as groups exceeding maximum occupancy, weddings, or other gatherings which create exclusive use of areas outside the shelter or additional impacts to public use of the park). To use shelters for these purposes requires both a shelter reservation and a Special Activity Permit which can be applied by contacting the park office at (360) 886-0148.
There are no designated parking spaces for shelter reservations. Parking is first-come first-serve.
